verdict.rationale: Restate is distributed as a single self-contained binary with no external dependencies, explicitly designed to be run yourself (self-hosted) as an alternative to Restate Cloud/BYOC, deployable on your own infra, containers, VMs, or Kubernetes. Community evidence (restate-comm-9) corroborates that the server/orchestration runs independently of any vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report of a full production self-hosted deployment, and clarity on licensing terms (BSL concerns raised in community comments) that could affect what 'self-host' fully entails commercially.
